basic_details.job_title: SCERT Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 5 Driver, Plumber and More Posts
basic_details.total_vacancies: Plumber, Driver, Office Attendant, Guest House Manager
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the age limit, the application fee, the daily wage amount, the selection process or the minimum educational qualification.

qualification.details: Applications are invited from candidates who have the prescribed qualification and work experience. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. See the official notification for the eligibility of each post.

how_to_apply: Prepare your application for the post.
Attach your biodata, qualification and work experience certificates, and an identity document.
Make sure the application reaches this address by the deadline: Director, SCERT, Vidya Bhavan, Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram 12.

content_sections.heading: About SCERT Kerala
content_sections.text: SCERT Kerala is a state educational research and training institution under the Government of Kerala. Its office is at Vidya Bhavan, Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram.

faq.question: Q1. Which post has the most vacancies?
faq.answer: Driver has the most, with 2 vacancies. Plumber, Office Attendant and Guest House Manager have 1 each.

faq.question: Q2. What must be sent with the application?
faq.answer: Send your biodata, qualification and work experience certificates, and an identity document.

faq.question: Q3. Where should the application be sent?
faq.answer: It goes to the Director, SCERT, at Vidya Bhavan, Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram 12.

faq.question: Q4. Is work experience required?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice invites applications from candidates who have both the prescribed qualification and work experience, and proof of experience must be attached.
